info.name: Blinding Beauty
info.description: The construction for my custom Blinding Beauty.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: As an action, you can force all humanoids within 30 feet of you that can see you to succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become blinded until the end of your next turn. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus. Once you use this ability, you can't use it again until you finish a short rest.
